name: x
description: A centered close mark with two balanced diagonal strokes.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested exact 2px outer margins in both styles on the native 24 by 24 grid. Outline diagonal centerlines span 2.85..21.15 on each axis, giving visible bounds 2..22 at Regular 1.70 with .85 round caps. Filled uses an upright solid rounded square with the same bounds 2..22 and radius-2.85 corners. The owner explicitly requested retaining another 2 units of inner clearance from the cutout to each box side, so its negative-space X has visible bounds 4..20, with centerline endpoints 4.85..19.15. The Filled glyph is intentionally smaller than the Outline glyph, while its stroke-equivalent width 1.70 and cap radius .85 stay unchanged. This is the boxed-inset-cutout exception to glyph contour equality; compare it against the Outline centerlines inset 2 units on each axis, keeping stroke/cap weight fixed. Coordinates are baked into source at X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
